appDomain.description:
The base part of the URLs being generated by the chart.

When using OpenShift, this should be the application domain, when can be evaluated by running the following
command: `oc -n openshift-ingress-operator get ingresscontrollers.operator.openshift.io default -o jsonpath='{.status.domain}'`.

partOf.description: The "part of" label when creating resources. This can help grouping together deployments.

openshift.description: Additional configuration settings in the context of OpenShift.

enabled.description:
Controls of OpenShift specific features are enabled. By default, the chart evaluate automatically if
the target cluster is OpenShift and will set the flag accordingly.

useServiceCa.description: Control the usage of the OpenShift service CA.

readOnly.description:
Global default for read-only mode. When true, the server rejects all mutating API
requests with 503 and the importer suspends all import jobs.
Can be overridden per module via modules.server.readOnly / modules.importer.readOnly.

replicas.description: The default number of replicas for scalable deployments.

enabled.description: Controls whether ingress resources should be created globally. Defaults to true for backward compatibility.

hosts.description:
Multiple hostnames for the ingress. If specified, overrides the single host configuration.
These hosts will be automatically used for TLS configuration if no explicit TLS config is provided.

tls.description:
TLS configuration for the ingress. Each item can specify hosts and secretName for TLS termination.
If not specified and hosts are defined, TLS will be automatically configured using the hosts.

port.description: Port on which infrastructure services are exposed.

initialDelaySeconds.description: The initial delay seconds for the infrastructure probes.

otelMetricExportInterval.description: The interval in milliseconds for exporting metrics. Will be used as the value for the `OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL` variable.

otelBspMaxExportBatchSize.description: The maximum batch size for exporting spans. Will be used as the value for the `OTEL_BSP_MAX_EXPORT_BATCH_SIZE` variable.

otelTracesSampler.description: The trace sampling strategy. Will be used as the value for the `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER` variable.

otelTracesSamplerArg.description: The trace sampling probability. Will be used as the value for the `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG` variable.

endpoint.description: OpenTelemetry collector endpoint for tracing and metrics.

additionalTrustAnchor.description: The path of the certificate to add to the list of trust anchors

maximumCacheSize.description: The maximum number of the bytes the analysis cache will hold before evicting entries.

recommendPatterns.description:
List of regex patterns for PURL vendor rebuild recommendations.
Each pattern must contain exactly one capture group extracting the upstream
base version (e.g. "^(.+)\\.redhat-[0-9]+$"). When empty, the server
returns no recommendations. Injected as TRUSTD_RECOMMEND_PATTERNS
comma-joined on the trustd Deployment.

ProxyConfig.description:
HTTP proxy configuration. When set, the corresponding environment variables
(HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, NO_PROXY) are injected into the importer container.

noProxy.description: Comma-separated list of hosts to bypass the proxy (sets NO_PROXY)

Scalable.description: Configuration options for a scalable deployment.

logFilter.description: Filter for the `env_logger` logging backend. Will be used as the value for the `RUST_LOG` variable.

backtrace.description: Allow enabling backtraces in Rust based application, by setting the value of `RUST_BACKTRACE` to `1`.

ImageConfig.description:
Configuration for the source of the container image. This can either be the full name of the image, or a
combination or registry, name, and version.

hosts.description:
Hostnames for the ingress. If not specified, defaults to [{service-name}{appDomain}].
These hosts will be automatically used for TLS configuration if no explicit TLS config is provided.

additionalAnnotations.description: Additional annotations which will be used as annotations on `Ingress` resources.

tls.description:
TLS configuration for the ingress. Each item can specify hosts and secretName for TLS termination.
If not specified and hosts are defined, TLS will be automatically configured using the hosts.

enabled.description:
A flag to enable/disable the whole feature. This can be used on individual modules to completely disable
their deployment.

AuthenticatorConfig.description:
The configuration file of the authentication process for all non-GUAC processes.

This can either be a full configuration file in either structured or string form. Or it can be a reference
to a config map, which is expected to contain a suitable configuration file.

By default, a suitable file will be created for the configured OIDC issuer solution used. The default OIDC issuer
is Keycloak. This can be overridden using the `type` property.

uiScope.description: Optional value for the `UI_SCOPE` environment variable in the server deployment.

insecure.description: Use insecure TLS when communicating with the issuer (DANGER!)

loadUser.description: Value for the `UI_LOAD_USER` environment variable in the server deployment

frontend.description: OIDC client configuration for the frontend/SPoG.

walker.description: OIDC client configuration for the backend.

testing-user.description: OIDC client for testing user operations during the Integration Test

testing-manager.description: OIDC client for testing manager operations during the Integration Test

ValueOrRef.description: Accepts either a direct value, or a reference to the source of the value.

name.description: The name of the config map

key.description: The name of the key inside the config map

accessKey.description: The access key/username to the storage resource

secretKey.description: The secret key/password to the storage resource

region.description: The AWS region of the bucket, or an endpoint.

compression.description: The compression algorithm used when storing documents.

minimumConnections.description: The minimum number of connections created in the connection pool.

maximumConnections.description: The maximum number of connections created in the connection pool.

Scheduled.description: Configuration options for a scheduled job.

oneOf.description: Size in bytes, allowing to use a unit such as KiB or MB.

workers.description:
The number of HTTP workers of the Actix application.

Also see: <https://actix.rs/docs/server/#multi-threading>

ExploitIntelligence.description:
Configuration for the Exploit Intelligence integration. When enabled, trustify can submit
SBOMs and CVEs to an external EI client service (agent-morpheus-client) for automated
vulnerability analysis and VEX document generation.

url.description: Base URL of the EI client service (agent-morpheus-client).

uiUrl.description: Base URL of the EI web UI for deep-linking to reports. Fallsback to base URL of the EI client service if unset.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts before a job is marked as failed.

workerPollInterval.description: How often the background worker checks for new EI jobs (humantime, e.g. "5s").

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent worker loops processing EI jobs.

ExploitIntelligenceOidc.description:
OIDC credentials for authenticating with the EI service using client credentials flow.
All three of clientId, clientSecret, and issuerUrl must be set together.

clientId.description: OIDC client ID for EI service authentication.

clientSecret.description: OIDC client secret for EI service authentication.

issuerUrl.description: OIDC issuer URL for EI service authentication (client credentials flow with discovery).

scope.description:
OAuth scope(s) to request in the client_credentials token request. Space-separated
when multiple scopes are needed. If unset, no scope parameter is sent.

refreshBefore.description: Duration an access token must still be valid before requesting a new one (humantime).

tlsInsecure.description: Allow insecure TLS connections with the EI OIDC issuer.

AuthConfig.description:
Authentication configuration for HTTP-based importers.

Wraps an [`AuthMethod`] whose credentials are resolved from
a [`CredentialSource`] at import time — not at configuration time.

AuthMethod.description: HTTP authentication method applied on each import request.

oneOf.description: Bearer token in the Authorization header.
Arbitrary header/value pair (e.g. API key headers).

CredentialSource.description:
How a credential value is sourced at import time.

Inline stores the value directly (dev only). Env and File store
only a reference — the value is resolved from the environment or
filesystem at each import run, enabling K8s Secret rotation.

oneOf.description:
Literal value stored in the database.

**Security:** the credential is stored in plaintext in the database.
Prefer [`CredentialSource::Env`] or [`CredentialSource::File`] for production use.
Name of an environment variable read at import time.
Filesystem path to a file whose content is read at import time.

HttpImporter.description:
Configuration for the HTTP-based importer.

Fetches documents from an HTTP repository, using a pluggable
discovery strategy to enumerate files and an optional credential
for authenticated sources.

disabled.description: A flag to disable the importer, without deleting it.

period.description: The period the importer should be run.

labels.description: Labels which will be applied to the ingested documents.

source.description: Base URL of the HTTP repository to import documents from.

discovery.description: File-discovery strategy used to enumerate files in the source.

auth.description: Optional authentication configuration for accessing the source.

onlyPatterns.description:
Optional list of regex patterns restricting which discovered files are
imported. An empty list imports all discovered files.

fetchRetries.description:
Number of fetch retries for individual file downloads.
Defaults to the fetcher's built-in retry count when absent.

HttpDiscovery.description: Pluggable file-discovery strategy for the HTTP importer.

oneOf.description: Discover files using the Pulp repository `PULP_MANIFEST` index.
